blurb: Guests participate in guided sea kayaking tours, whale watching from motorized skiffs, hiking, and camping in natural settings such as Magdalena Bay and the Sea of Cortez. Trips include wildlife encounters with gray whales, blue whales, dolphins, and birdwatching in mangroves. Accommodations range from safari-style base camps on secluded beaches to hotels, with meals and expert naturalist guides provided.
